summary: Iteration 45: Cart and Checkout Flow Testing - All critical features verified and working. Guest browsing, AddToCartPopup, CartPage with trust badges, CheckoutAuthModal (WhatsApp OTP + Email + Signup), and Checkout page with GPS button all functioning correctly.

minor.issue: Returns 404 - endpoint may not exist or have different path

critical_code_review_comments: All cart and checkout components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
CheckoutAuthModal correctly handles WhatsApp OTP, Email login, and Signup flows
CartPage shows trust badges (COD Available, Fast Delivery, Easy Returns) and WhatsApp help link
AddToCartPopup has 'Continue Shopping' and 'Go to Cart' buttons working correctly
/checkout route shows auth modal for guests instead of redirecting to /auth page
Guest cart uses localStorage (pigma_guest_cart key) and syncs to server on login
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart and checkout flow fully functional. Key routes: /products (guest browsing), /product/{id} (product detail with AddToCartPopup), /cart-page (full cart page with trust badges), /checkout (shows CheckoutAuthModal for guests). OTP endpoints at /api/auth/otp/send and /api/auth/otp/verify return demo_otp for testing. WhatsApp OTP is MOCKED (demo mode). Razorpay payments are MOCKED.
